```{=html}
<style>
.energy-phase-demo {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 22px;
  width: min(1160px, 100%);
  margin: 0.35rem auto 0;

.energy-phase-panel {

}

}

.energy-phase-arrow.is-blue {

}

.energy-phase-arrow.is-gold {

}

.energy-phase-tip.is-blue {

}

.energy-phase-tip.is-gold {

}

.energy-phase-origin {

}

.energy-phase-label {

  font-size: 18px;

}

.energy-phase-muted-label {

.energy-phase-track {

</style>

<div class="energy-phase-demo" data-energy-phase-demo role="img"
     aria-label="Сравнение общей фазы состояния с одной энергией и относительной фазы суперпозиции двух энергий">
  <div class="energy-phase-panel">
    <div class="energy-phase-title">Одна энергия <i>E</i></div>
    <div class="energy-phase-subtitle">Вектор амплитуды вращается как целое</div>
    <svg class="energy-phase-svg" viewBox="0 0 500 220" aria-hidden="true">
      <line class="energy-phase-axis" x1="142" y1="110" x2="358" y2="110"></line>
      <line class="energy-phase-axis" x1="250" y1="15" x2="250" y2="205"></line>
      <circle class="energy-phase-circle" cx="250" cy="110" r="78"></circle>
      <line class="energy-phase-arrow is-blue" data-single-arrow x1="250" y1="110" x2="328" y2="110"></line>
      <circle class="energy-phase-tip is-blue" data-single-tip cx="328" cy="110" r="7"></circle>
      <circle class="energy-phase-origin" cx="250" cy="110" r="4"></circle>
      <text class="energy-phase-label" x="354" y="105">Re</text>
      <text class="energy-phase-label" x="258" y="28">Im</text>
      <text class="energy-phase-muted-label" x="328" y="54">e⁻ⁱᴱᵗ</text>
    </svg>
    <div class="energy-phase-readout">
      <span>Общая фаза меняется</span>
      <strong data-single-phase>0.00 rad</strong>
    </div>
    <div class="energy-phase-bar-row">
      <span><i>P</i>(<i>E</i>)</span>
      <div class="energy-phase-track"><div class="energy-phase-fill"></div></div>
      <span class="energy-phase-value">1.00</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="energy-phase-panel is-superposition">
    <div class="energy-phase-title">Две энергии <i>E</i><sub>1</sub> ≠ <i>E</i><sub>2</sub></div>
    <div class="energy-phase-subtitle">Измеряем |+⟩ = (|E₁⟩ + |E₂⟩)/√2</div>
    <svg class="energy-phase-svg" viewBox="0 0 500 220" aria-hidden="true">
      <line class="energy-phase-axis" x1="142" y1="110" x2="358" y2="110"></line>
      <line class="energy-phase-axis" x1="250" y1="15" x2="250" y2="205"></line>
      <circle class="energy-phase-circle" cx="250" cy="110" r="78"></circle>
      <line class="energy-phase-arrow is-blue" data-double-arrow-one x1="250" y1="110" x2="328" y2="110"></line>
      <circle class="energy-phase-tip is-blue" data-double-tip-one cx="328" cy="110" r="7"></circle>
      <line class="energy-phase-arrow is-gold" data-double-arrow-two x1="250" y1="110" x2="328" y2="110"></line>
      <circle class="energy-phase-tip is-gold" data-double-tip-two cx="328" cy="110" r="7"></circle>
      <circle class="energy-phase-origin" cx="250" cy="110" r="4"></circle>
      <text class="energy-phase-label" x="354" y="105">Re</text>
      <text class="energy-phase-label" x="258" y="28">Im</text>
      <text class="energy-phase-muted-label" x="320" y="48" fill="#7cc7ff">E₁</text>
      <text class="energy-phase-muted-label" x="320" y="68" fill="#ffcc8a">E₂</text>
    </svg>
    <div class="energy-phase-readout">
      <span>Относительная фаза Δφ</span>
      <strong data-relative-phase>0.00 rad</strong>
    </div>
    <div class="energy-phase-energy-row">
      <div class="energy-phase-energy-chip"><i>P</i>(<i>E</i><sub>1</sub>) = 1/2</div>
      <div class="energy-phase-energy-chip"><i>P</i>(<i>E</i><sub>2</sub>) = 1/2</div>
    </div>
    <div class="energy-phase-bar-row">
      <span><i>P</i>(+)</span>
      <div class="energy-phase-track"><div class="energy-phase-fill is-dynamic" data-interference-bar></div></div>
      <span class="energy-phase-value" data-interference-value>1.00</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const TAU = 2 * Math.PI;

  function setArrow(line, tip, phase) {
    const cx = 250;
    const cy = 110;
    const radius = 78;
    const x = cx + radius * Math.cos(phase);
    const y = cy - radius * Math.sin(phase);
    line.setAttribute("x2", x.toFixed(2));
    line.setAttribute("y2", y.toFixed(2));
    tip.setAttribute("cx", x.toFixed(2));
    tip.setAttribute("cy", y.toFixed(2));
  }

  function initialize(root) {
    if (root.dataset.energyPhaseReady === "true") return;
    root.dataset.energyPhaseReady = "true";

    const singleArrow = root.querySelector("[data-single-arrow]");
    const singleTip = root.querySelector("[data-single-tip]");
    const doubleArrowOne = root.querySelector("[data-double-arrow-one]");
    const doubleTipOne = root.querySelector("[data-double-tip-one]");
    const doubleArrowTwo = root.querySelector("[data-double-arrow-two]");
    const doubleTipTwo = root.querySelector("[data-double-tip-two]");
    const singlePhaseText = root.querySelector("[data-single-phase]");
    const relativePhaseText = root.querySelector("[data-relative-phase]");
    const interferenceBar = root.querySelector("[data-interference-bar]");
    const interferenceValue = root.querySelector("[data-interference-value]");

    const omega = 1.25;
    const omegaOne = 0.82;
    const omegaTwo = 1.52;
    const start = performance.now();

    function draw(now) {
      if (!document.body.contains(root)) return;

      const slide = root.closest("section");
      if (!slide || slide.classList.contains("present")) {
        const time = (now - start) / 1000;
        const singlePhase = (omega * time) % TAU;
        const phaseOne = (omegaOne * time) % TAU;
        const phaseTwo = (omegaTwo * time) % TAU;
        const relativePhase = ((phaseTwo - phaseOne) % TAU + TAU) % TAU;
        const probability = 0.5 * (1 + Math.cos(relativePhase));

        setArrow(singleArrow, singleTip, -singlePhase);
        setArrow(doubleArrowOne, doubleTipOne, -phaseOne);
        setArrow(doubleArrowTwo, doubleTipTwo, -phaseTwo);

        singlePhaseText.textContent = `${singlePhase.toFixed(2)} rad`;
        relativePhaseText.textContent = `${relativePhase.toFixed(2)} rad`;
        interferenceBar.style.width = `${(100 * probability).toFixed(1)}%`;
        interferenceValue.textContent = probability.toFixed(2);
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }

  function initializeAll() {
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-energy-phase-demo]").forEach(initialize);
  }

  initializeAll();
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeAll, {once: true});
})();
</script>
```
